# meshctl

> Unprivileged MeshTransit command-line client written in Go.

## Read first

- README.md: commands, build instructions, and security boundary
- docs/linux-packaging.md: Debian package build, contents, and installation
- AGENTS.md: mandatory instructions for coding agents
- ../meshd/docs/architecture.md: daemon and compatibility architecture when both repositories are checked out together

## Core invariants

- Communicate with meshd only through its versioned local API.
- Never read daemon state or hold control and node private keys.
- Never accept or send a client-selected network identifier.
- Keep compatibility implementation and tunnel code out of this repository.
- Keep public terminology under the MeshTransit product names.
